description: Tasks template for the SupplyChain Worker messaging modernization plan.

tasks.description: Capture the current application state and define the frozen verification baseline.
tasks.requirements: Snapshot the application's main source directory, src/main/java, before the migration. Produce the frozen test specification and dependency real/mock decision table for integration verification. Use mocked dependencies because no Azure test infrastructure is provided.

tasks.description: Move the worker's notification messaging from RabbitMQ to Azure Service Bus.
tasks.reason: The project documents RabbitMQ as legacy messaging and identifies Azure Service Bus as its modernization target.
tasks.requirements: Migrate the order-created, inventory-alert, and approval-pending consumers and their messaging configuration from RabbitMQ to Azure Service Bus. Preserve the existing notification-processing responsibilities and use managed identity for Azure authentication. Do not include an application runtime upgrade or deployment.

tasks.description: Build integration tests for migrated Azure services and run post-migration verification
tasks.requirements: Use mocked dependencies and the frozen baseline specification to verify the migrated order-created, inventory-alert, and approval-pending message-processing flows.

tasks.description: Scan project dependencies for known CVEs and remediate identified vulnerabilities.
tasks.requirements: Scan all project dependencies for known CVEs and upgrade vulnerable dependencies to minimum patched versions. If remediation requires a major version upgrade, document the affected dependency, current and upgraded versions, and breaking-change risk. Verify the project builds and all tests pass.
